data.cultural_impact: The name Pradyotana holds significant cultural value in the Hindu tradition as it symbolizes the power of enlightenment and knowledge. The prefix 'Pradyo-' represents the beginning or commencement of an illuminating truth or wisdom, making the name an inspiring reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and spreading light in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, Pradyotana signifies the inner awakening and transformation that comes with seeking knowledge and understanding of the self and the universe.This name resonates with one's deepest desire for self-realization and reminds us of our infinite potential to grow and evolve on our spiritual journey. The name Pradyotana is a powerful reminder of the inner flame that drives us towards the discovery of our true purpose and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Pradyotana, a Shaka king, is mentioned in the Ashoka inscription of Girnar. He is believed to have ruled from around 130 BCE to 100 BCE.
historical_references.context: An inscription discovered at Girnar mentions a Shaka king named Pradyotana, providing evidence of the Shaka rule in Gujarat around this time.

historical_references.reference: Pradyotana, king of the Satavahana dynasty, is mentioned in the Allahabad Pillar Edict of Emperor Ashoka. His reign is dated to around 267 BCE.
historical_references.context: An inscription discovered at Allahabad mentions a king named Pradyotana of the Satavahana dynasty, indicating that he was a contemporary of Emperor Ashoka.
